name: Ananya Reddy
quote: Tanah feels less like a restaurant and more like an architectural exhibition. Savoring claypot-cooked dishes amidst basalt arches is a sensory revelation.

name: Vikram Sen
quote: The rooftop embers experience in Hyderabad is unmatched. By focusing on pure soil harvests and wood fire, they've set a premium benchmark for contemporary Indian dining.
